# AORMS

AORMS stands for Accelerated Operational Resources Management System — a platform for AEC consulting firms and project management consultancies (architecture, engineering, and PMC practices that advise and govern projects).

AORMS is NOT contractor ERP and NOT a full Primavera/MSP replacement. It provides an operational framework (how the office runs) and a design framework (how engagements are structured) on one spine, with **EOMS** (external knowledge bank) and **ESTI** (internal AI agent).

Three apps on one platform:
- **AStudio** (*Accelerated Studio*) — architecture consultancy workspace for Indian architecture and design practices (live at studio.aorms.in)
- **AConsulting** (*Accelerated Consulting*) — engineering consultancy workspace for structural, MEP, civil, and multidisciplinary firms (live at consultancy.aorms.in)
- **AProc** (*Accelerated Project Management*) — PMC workspace for project management consultancies (preview at proc.aorms.in) — programme, packages, sealed contractor bids, RA/steel certification, BBS, P6 XER milestone import

Platform home: https://aorms.in/
Architecture app (sign in): https://aorms.in/login · https://studio.aorms.in
Engineering app: https://consultancy.aorms.in
PMC app: https://proc.aorms.in
Blog: https://aorms.in/blog
Central wiki: https://aorms.in/wiki (path may redirect to platform home while docs consolidate)

AStudio capabilities:
- Fee recovery — what needs invoicing, next payment stage, receipts, due dates, GST reminders
- Client revision management — MoM → ESTI extracts → client request → architect criticality → client approves
- Drawing register, transmittals, and client approval workflows
- Pre-construction R&O — risks, opportunities, design phase gates
- COA fee proposals and GST invoicing with reconciliation
- Studio Intelligence dashboard and Ask ESTI (BYO API key supported)
- **EOMS** — Emergent Object Management System (knowledge bank); **ESTI** — internal AI agent
- **Desktop preferred + web parity** — WinUI local-first node and browser SPA; one Standard licence; AI unmetered (local on desktop, hub on web)
- **Pure neumorphism** UI (`@hcw/ui-kit` 1.5.0) — opaque soft chrome, 8px radius; signed installers at /downloads when packaging ships

AProc capabilities (owner-side PMC governance — not contractor labour ERP):
- Master programme milestones (CSV + Primavera P6 XER import)
- Package tender invites with sealed contractor-portal bids
- RA bill and steel certification; BBS (IS 456) + steel reconciliation
- Progress reports, snags, site supervision on the Delivery spine

Website:
https://aorms.in
